additions.name: China Mobile Beijing International Information Port No6 / C18 Data Center Development

status.summary: Official supervision procurement candidate notice dated September 1 confirms the No6/C18 development. Two planned data-center buildings plus associated power buildings are one project at the existing campus. Procurement and scheduled service dates do not establish physical works or a government construction permission.

locator.precision: Representative marker inside the existing mapped Phase3 sector of China Mobile International Information Port. Locates the wider named campus only; it does not locate No6/C18, a new data-center building, a parcel boundary, or the full-campus centroid.
locator.identity_review: Official No6/C18 notices identify China Mobile International Information Port in Changping at the North Sixth Ring / Badaling Expressway junction. OSM way768393624 is explicitly named China Mobile International Information Port Phase3; the operator contact page corroborates Phase3 at Manbai Road, Shahe, Changping. Point is the arithmetic bounding-box center of that polygon and is verified inside it. The May26 official design notice says southeast C18 whereas July9/September1 official notices say northeast; neither direction is resolved by this marker. OSM Phase6 is not asserted to be No6 parcel.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Community mapping gives no measured positional accuracy. Offset from the existing Phase3 marker to No6/C18 is unknown; numeric precision is arithmetic/source precision, not survey accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: Reviewed 419 projects, 395 sites and all 231 original imported records. No Beijing/Changping/International Information Port project or source alias occurs. Existing CN records are Haidong Phase2, Shaotang Shaoguan and Guizhou B5/B6. Nearest existing site is LG Uplus Paju AIDC, 945.43km away. No6/C18 is one development within one campus; phases mapped in OSM are not extra projects or sites.
additions.successor_review: Reviewed official September1 procurement notice and project registration on October13. A later September9 supervision award is indexed in secondary mirrors but its primary page was not recovered; it would remain procurement evidence. No verified later physical start, completion, operation, cancellation or granted development/building permit found. OSM commercial/construction tags and version dates are not lifecycle evidence.

additions.name: Datum FRN2 Data Centre Building

status.summary: Operator reports frame erected, stair/precast and architectural metalwork installation, and roof construction beginning. This is a dated current work report; completed shell, fit-out, commissioning and operation are not established.

locator.precision: Google Maps feature for Datum Datacentres selected by the operator. Parent campus marker only; not a surveyed FRN2 point, new-building centroid, footprint or legal boundary.
locator.identity_review: Datum states FRN2 is linked adjacent to FRN1 at its Farnborough campus and publishes the exact Maps link in the footer. That link resolves to the named Datum Datacentres feature. Source -0.7967507,51.2803199 is distinct from viewport longitude -0.7993256.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No measured positional accuracy or FRN2 boundary is published. Source decimal digits are retained without an accuracy claim.

additions.distinctness_review: No Datum, FRN1, FRN2, Cody Technology Park or Farnborough named project occurs in the 419-project base. Nearest recorded project is Iron Mountain LON-3 about 29.36 km away. FRN2 is one new project at one previously uncatalogued Datum campus; existing FRN1 is locator context, not another addition.
additions.successor_review: September 25 report still calls FRN2 construction ongoing but dates the visit only as last week. Retain exact September 4 progress observation. Current operator site targets 2027 go-live, not achieved operation.

additions.name: NTT Munich 2 Operating Campus

status.summary: NTT’s October 7 announcement explicitly places the newly opened AI Factory inside its live Munich 2 Data Center. Confirms current operation of the existing campus; original campus opening was May 18, 2017. No claim that a new campus or all campus capacity opened in October 2026.

locator.precision: Source-supplied reference point for OSM industrial building way 452201257, whose street, house number, postcode and town match the operator’s Munich 2 address. Campus locator only; not a verified AI Factory hall, building A/B allocation, entrance, legal parcel or campus boundary.
locator.identity_review: NTT official campus page names Landshuter Straße 7, 85716 Unterschleißheim. Nominatim and raw OSM way 452201257 match all address components. OSM has no operator/name tag, so identity rests on the explicit exact-address match; community edits do not establish status.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No measured horizontal accuracy, current imagery inspection or exact AI deployment footprint. Numerical precision does not imply surveyed accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: No NTT Munich 2/Unterschleissheim/Landshuter named campus occurs in the 419-project baseline. Existing Portus MUC2 is a different operator in Kirchheim at Marsstraße 5, about 20.76 km away; it is not an alias. Nearest existing site is Deutsche Telekom Industrial AI Cloud, Munich Tucherpark about 15.68 km away. Add one campus and one campus project; AI Factory is a hosted use, not another physical site.
additions.successor_review: October 7 primary announcement describes live production data-center operation and an achieved AI Factory opening that day. Current operator facility page corroborates campus address and operating service offering. Historical 2017 campus opening is preserved independently.
